title_zh: 广州港：千年商都的海上门户
title_en: China's Ports (4/20): Guangzhou, Sea Gateway of a Thousand-Year-Old Trading City
note_en: 早在…就已经… stresses that something happened surprisingly long ago: 早在两千多年前，广州就已经通过海上丝绸之路与海外国家进行贸易 "As far back as two thousand years ago, Guangzhou was already trading with overseas countries." 早在 ("as early as") goes before the time phrase, and 就已经 ("already then") before the verb. English usually marks this once ("as far back as" or "already"), but Chinese naturally marks it twice.
